name: F1 Pro Pine – Rugged Dumbphone-Talk Only with Numberlink
short_description:
Life can hand out some hard knocks. You need a phone that can keep up.

The new F1 Pro series of flip phones has a much larger battery, improved durability, water resistance, and better screen.

All Pro phones purchased after July 1, 2026 now come standard with a 2 year warranty!

The F1 Pro Pine rugged dumbphone without media is perfect for the person who wants a phone that has talk and basic texting, but without the ability to send and receive pictures or music.

description:
Life can hand out some hard knocks. You need a phone that can keep up.

That’s why we’re introducing the new F1 Pro series of flip phones, with a much larger battery, improved durability, water resistance, USB-C, and better screen.

Each kosher phone comes complete with a battery, a USB-C wall charger, a charging dock, and a charging cord.

We’re also introducing a number of new software feature-levels to better serve your desired level of freedom from distraction.

The F1 Pro Pine rugged dumbphone without media has the following features:

  • Touchscreen
  • Camera
  • Visual Voicemail
  • Bluetooth- Not compatible with Apple Airpods
  • Wi-Fi (data transfer)
  • TAG Approval
  • NumberLink*   The Pine phone does not have texting on the phone but with Numberlink you can text from a computer or tablet using your regular phone number.
  • Calls to A.I. numbers are blocked

 

It does NOT have:

  • Multimedia Messaging
  • Offline Music Player
  • Weather
  • Navigation
  • Sound Recorder
  • Wi-Fi Hotspot
  • Any Google apps
  • Web browser
  • Social Media apps
  • App Store
  • Video capability

 

See the F1 Pro spec sheet for more details.

Note: The F1 Pro Pine rugged kosher phone without media is meant for North and South America and will not work in much of Europe, Africa, and Asia because it lacks the LTE bands required in those locations. See our Coverage page for more info.

*NumberLink and Talk to Text require a subscription.
